critical_findings.description: Displayed candidates are produced using source_curve_hypotheses insertion order and legacyId <144, not independently ranked Next decisions
Completion requires independently persisted chemcore decision; upstream asynchronous creation/telemetry recording not shown as transactional end-to-end handshake
6 s telemetry freshness, 12 s startup/flush wait, application Activity-owned timer, explicit relay cleanup; all can cause incomplete operation if not coordinated
Requires at least ten unique MQ scan cycles; physical/particles 10 eligible samples; invalid input prevents completion
Uses historic V6/legacy ChemCoreInferenceEngine, not new ChemCoreNext; needs single decision path and frozen R0
Settings opens calibration via lazily created DeveloperR0Tab; past user opening/calibration failures require Android recreation reproduction, not assumed fixed
Legacy 144 screening view and posterior presentation plus several report writers can diverge from Next decision
ExperimentsDb currently DB_VERSION 14 and no adopted Next-specific immutable decision schema
P06.3 and P06.5 pending in prior state; source-specific G3 calibration never established; public release blocked
User observed failures; software code and emulator/device evidence necessary before classifying root cause
